transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I just... I don't care about anything anymore. I used to do art classes, go to board-game nights, hike... I even wanted to get back on my soccer team. But now I just sit in my room and let everything slip away. Nothing matters to me now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
Yeah, I really have. Most days, I just wake up with this... this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It's hard to explain, but it feels like there’s just no future for me beyond my apartment walls.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, sure, but... nothing like this. I've never felt this completely empty or stuck before. This is the first time it's ever been this bad.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or wired for several days in a row?
No, I haven't. I don't think I've ever felt like that. Honestly, it's usually the exact opposite... I'm just exhausted all the time. I've definitely never had days where I felt wired or energized.
Did this start after something stressful or upsetting happened in your life?
Yeah, I guess it did. It started right after my divorce... so, it's been about a year and eleven months now that I've been feeling this way.
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself?

Yes. I just... I keep having thoughts that I don't want to wake up anymore. It's just so heavy. And recently, when my friend came over and found me, I guess I had been saying out loud that I couldn't keep living like this.
Have you been able to take care of basic daily things like showering, eating, or paying bills?

No, not really. I've pretty much stopped taking any freelance art-education work. I don't go to community events or play soccer anymore, either. And... well, I need my friend checking on me, honestly, because I'm not reliably eating or showering. I'm just not doing a good job keeping myself safe or taking care of things.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?

Yes, I do. Um... there's a woman's voice that I hear coming from the corner of my room. She tells me that I ruined everything and that I should just stay inside. And... it's not like a thought in my head. It sounds exactly like someone is standing right next to my bed speaking to me.
